name: remocn
description: Make Remotion videos from remocn components: brief to storyboard to a rendering project, with visual QA and a hand-off to Remocn Studio.

interface.shortDescription: Remotion videos from ready-made remocn components
interface.longDescription: Pick components from the remocn registry, plan a storyboard, install with shadcn and compose a Remotion video that renders. Works in a coding agent with a terminal; in chat it searches components and plans videos through the remocn.dev MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second product demo video for my app with remocn.
Turn the last release of this repo into a changelog video.
Find a remocn transition for a fast, techy cut.
